title: Changing a part's number to one already stocked here is refused
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Two active parts, {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-RENDUP-01) and {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-RENDUP-02), are stocked at {Location-A}.
  • {Number-A} (for example zzautotest pl rendup 01) matches {Part-A} once upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods and spaces are ignored, and no Part Library entry has exactly the number {Number-A}.
custom_steps:
1. At {Location-A}, go to Parts → Inventory and type {Part-B} in the search.
  2. Click the {Part-B} row.
  3. Replace the Part Number with {Number-A}.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Click Cancel.
  6. Type {Part-B} in the search again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: the change is not saved. A red message reads "{Part-A} already exists at this location." with a second, smaller line "Please try to resolve this." It goes away after about 3 seconds, and the window stays open.
  • Step 5: the window closes.
  • Step 6: one row still reads {Part-B}: it kept its number.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S7-N5b, S7-N3, S7-N5, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 2.2 (Both fields edited), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-N5b: “S7-N3 and S7-N4 apply when a part is created and when its part number is changed. Saving a part with its number unchanged is never refused by them, even when the location already holds a part whose number matches it.”
  • S7-N3: “If a part with the same number is already stocked at this location and is active, the save is refused with "{part number} already exists at this location."”
  • S7-N5: “For S7-N3 and S7-N4, "the same number" ignores upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods, spaces and other blank characters. The message names the number of the part already there.”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (New part's number already stocked here, active): “"{part number} already exists at this location." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary context note: “every refusal sent by the system, the rows that fade after 3 seconds, also shows a second, smaller line under the message: "Please try to resolve this."”
